live.note: Recorded from the lower of two consecutive live runs against the tightened audit event mapper: run 1 scored 24/24 with contract 1.0, run 2 scored 21/24 with contract 0.9149. Run 2 is taken wholesale because it is lower or equal on every guarded metric, so the baseline is a floor rather than a peak. Live scoring is nondeterministic; the run-2 shortfalls were scout.explicit-grill-session, scout.resume-partial-sweep, and relay.bounded-single-task. This supersedes the stale entry recorded at e59d152, which was inflated by the pre-fix mapper.
